items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: Al Jolson was the only white man he that had a card to come in there.

ctx.x: Yeah. Al Jolson was the only white man he that had a card to come in there. And nobody stopped him. But, Baron had a lot of the boys around there, a lot of the sportsmen around there, used to come upstairs and playing

and gambling and like that. But, because they sharped the white women, they wouldn't have them down there because the white women were the girl friends and the wives of the gangsters. And the beer barons was going at that time, you see?
